target.title: chore(deps): refresh runtime and tooling dependencies
target.body:
## Summary

- refresh 29 runtime dependencies and 8 development dependencies to current published versions
- keep the existing pnpm supply-chain policy and lockfile integrity metadata
- update the Radix UI patch set, Supabase client, charts/animation libraries, Tailwind/Vite, and Oxc tooling

## Risk

Medium: broad dependency-only refresh touching runtime UI/data libraries and build tooling; no application source or configuration behavior changes.

## Proof

- `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`
- `pnpm lint`
- `pnpm typecheck`
- `pnpm test` — 28 files, 234 tests
- `pnpm test:coverage` — 28 files, 234 tests; 77.31% statements
- `SKIP_ENV_VALIDATION=true pnpm build`
- production build HTTP smoke: `/` 200, unknown appcast 404 JSON, unsupported ingest GET 405
- `pnpm audit --json` — 0 vulnerabilities
- `pnpm outdated --format json` — no remaining direct updates
- autoreview (Codex gpt-5.5) — clean, no accepted/actionable findings
- public model identifier gate — PASS; no model-bearing source or artifacts in the candidate

No changelog entry: dependency-only maintenance with no intended user-visible behavior change.
